metadata.name: TypeSafe
metadata.description: Typed decisions from TypeSafe's Jev model: route, classify, score or answer yes/no over any state, with probabilities and confidence. Reaches TypeSafe directly or through OpenRouter.

methods.name: OpenRouter API key
methods.notes: Same request and response body as TypeSafe. A model without a slash is prefixed with typesafe/ so jev-latest works on both paths.

commonFields.label: Base URL (optional)
commonFields.description: Override the endpoint, for example a proxy or a future API version.

config.testConnection: POST one noul question ({state:'ping', questions:{ok:{type:'noul',instructions:'Is the word ping present?'}}}) with the selected credential; status ok on 2xx, else failed with the API's message.

operations.name: evaluate
operations.description: Evaluate a state against a map of typed questions. Returns one typed answer per question: choice (option + probabilities + confidence), score (weighted level + probabilities + confidence) or noul (probability that the answer is yes).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Text or JSON to decide about. A string is sent as-is; anything that parses as JSON is sent as structured state.

parameters.name: questions
parameters.placeholder: {"route": {"type": "choice", "instructions": "Which team should handle this?", "criteria": {"billing": "Payments, invoicing, refunds", "technical": "Bugs, outages", "sales": "Pricing, upgrades"}}}
parameters.description: Map of question id to {type: choice|score|noul, instructions, criteria}. Answers come back under the same ids.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Defaults to jev-latest on TypeSafe and typesafe/jev-1.13 on OpenRouter.

schema.answers: map<id, {type, choice?, score?, noul?, probabilities?, legend?, confidence?}>

input.state: The dome shutter stops midway through the nightly calibration.
input.questions: {"assignment":{"type":"choice","instructions":"Which observatory team should inspect this?","criteria":{"mechanical":"Shutters, gears, drive motors","optical":"Mirrors, lenses, focus alignment","scheduling":"Observation slots and crew assignments"}}}

testCases.name: malformed questions is a 422 before the request

uiExpectations.notes: Two credential branches, one endpoint per branch. Nothing else.
